translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: Anu wasaingic enara mong kpara Yurio, yeng Sisaac habu, imohacnac wasaingic 100 garengyunuec. Nga Itaria bangecfu kennideac naso wegeneu ngictaungo deu Pauro nga witicngic goa Yurio yeac mariu faiyunugec, yeng meyunuu yenahafoc kporucwageu enggec.

Nga wage imoc Adramiteng taonnunac amma Asia bangec dumbengau modacma taong tackenec, ihai enudeac dedea, neni wage imohainoc emma Tesaronikenac makedoniangic mong kpara Aristako, yegoc nenahafoc kening.
Wereckengau wage Sidong taonnu emmanu Yuriongo Pauro ogo ammima negemmiu taonnu keng emma ogofora yugucyunuu heimefic ammigec.
Nga wageu monggoc emma taong wamina firangngo kennideugeng haecac Kipiro nuc nga Asia bangec botucngirau kening.
Kemma Kirikia nga Pamfiria bangec ferecgema kengkecma Mira taonnu Rikia bangecfu kensikeing.
Kensikeni ihai Aresandria taonnunac kporucwage mong tacma Itaria bangecfu kembeso anec. Nga wasaingic enarango imoc meficgema ihai menunuu ening.
Emma uameme goa dengec dengec kengkecma ua ebiriangoc mema Kinido taong tarecfugeng sikeing. Sikeni firangngo kpemerennunuu Kreta nucfugeng kening.
Kengkecma nuc imocac dumbenga mong kpara Sarimone ferecgema Rasaia mewegenema kondung medaha mong feec, kpara Wage bris gombunga, neni uaesa mekecmangoc ihai ening.
Kondunnu naso herea kengkefing amma kianomang naso mewegenenunu kecma memanganenunubacac Paurongo goroyoac yofi deec,
“Ngicwiac, yoc monggoc kennide negemba heocnenide. Wage nga finacsac kpac, ngic nenahafoc kondunnu kemebinggac.” imoc hemma negenduae.
Ifi edeu wasaigareng yeng ine Pauroac yoac mi negensinggema wagegareng nga wage mingina yereac yoac negemma tofohoec.

Nga kondung medaha bic henggec wagengo ihai kianomanggoc tatacacsoc mi anec. Ifi anu yeni imoc wama Kreta nuc imocac taong mong brisiagoc kpara Foiniki, ihai naric endacma tacmagec kianomang naso wisickeudeac homacngo degec. Ihai mura seria mi kpeande, yowarecngosac efea kpeande.
Anu kondunggac firang firang gombunga kpeu wagengic yeneng degec, “Naric kennide.” dema angka kpedzigec ereu Kreta nuc kpegegenggema kening.
Kemmina naso mi hereemanu firang kpara murango nuc ferecgema wage sebikpengau kucgoc kpeec.
Kpema wage mefaheu firanggac kucfu wage garenggegecdeac ambibiema wagec firanggac songou kenu kening.
Kengkecma nuc kapia mong kpara Kauda, imoc wadzahemima kemmina dinggi kondunnu kemebeso anu mi mebinggacsoc

uaesa mekecma dinggi wage witiau kpedzima faiing. Nga wage tohobacac imoc witicngo meserima kpefuseing. Kpefusema dzegema Siriti sangiu, ihai embinggac amma wage yomeaac kporuc kuneng kpedzigec mau firangngo fifinunuu kening.
Kenni firang kuhagoc kpema feu memanganenunubacac wereckengau finac goa kondunnu ukugec kemeec.
Kemeu hadzing tofocnac harebec anu wageac finac goa monggoc ukugec kemeec.
Kemeu hadzing tofocnac homac firang yadango kpema feec. Feu neni wenac me asomeng mong mi fingeru hemma negen negennina fonggou kekecnina mi fingerudeac negening.

Anu ngic yeni naso herea nenedoku wama kecmagec Paurongo kemma botucnginau namma yofi edeyunuec, “Ngicwiac, ngeni neac yoac negembau dede Kreta nuc mi wabing. Amma forangoc, wage mi manganeu finac naric mi ukubing.
Nga nenang botucfunac mongngo mi kpac anudeac ubangina kuha mi mabeso. Nga wage ine kpedzameude.
Worang tofocnac Anutunaac enac tofoc tofohoya kecduae, yeac angero mongngo nearu hama namma

yofi edenudac, ‘Pauro, mi kengecguu, ge Roma ngictau Sisa yeac kicfu nambesena, imoc fingecbeso. Anutungo geac nunumuac amma yofi dede, “Ngic yomoc ngeni wageu kecdae, ngenearunac mongngo mi kpac anude.” ’
Imocac ngic yomoc ngeni ubangina ngereeu. Anutungo yoac edenuande, imoc ifi fingerude, imoc negensinggeduae.
Anu wagengo ine nuc monnu enu wani nedzamebeso.”
Ifi deu Adria kondunnu meang kpeang kecmina hadzing tofocnac 14 anec. Amma tofocnac dzongiau wagengic yeni bangec mewegene
negemma kpete ukugec kemeu mita 36 anec. Iohanec wisicke kemma kpete monggoc ukugec kemeu mita 27 anec.
Anu hoc witiau embinggac dema kengecyunuu wage buyau angka 4 ukugec kemeu ama wereckenudeac numugec.
Numumagec wagengic yeni wage wama worabeso negensima wage dinggia faigec kemeu ikoc amma yofi degec, “Neni wage dumbengau angka mong faini kemeude.”
Ifi degec Paurongo wasaigareng nga ngicfora yofi edeyunuec, “Wagengic woragecdeu ngeni komoc mi kpegecde.”
Edeyunuu wasaingic yeni dinggiac witic herecgegec kondunnu kemeec.
Kemeu ama werec wereckenggac Paurongo ngic yeni yaka negecdeac ngombongyunuma yofi edeyunuec, “Ngeni ebicfu yaka wama kecmagec, yaguc uameme 14 ande.
Herenginango yakaac derecgemanu yaka mi nene kecma homebauac ngombongngunuma deduae.” Ifi dema yofi deec, “Ngeni ubayohoc mi anggec nocac orucdzongina mong mi mama sufuude.”
Ifi deu yeni sasawango hemmagec kicnginau ic sogong mong mema Anutu dangge edema merecgema neec.
Neu yeni imoc hemma ubangina ngereeu ifingoc yaka nedacgec.
Ngic wageu kefing, neneac kpetenina 276.
Anu yaka negec gebecyunuu wage efaiudeac wit homac wageu feec, imoc kondunnu ukugec kemeu wage efaiec.
Ama wereckenu bangec mi hehenaac hembibiegec. Amma kondung medaha mong hoc kpahac sangisac feu yeni imoc hemma wage imohai naric enudeac degec.
Ifi degec ngic yeneng angka witicngina herecgegec kondunnu kemeu naso socfungoc wage gombunga garenggegecdeac somba yungecma kporuc kpedzigec enu firang kporucfu kpeu kondung kpendzicma kenggec.
Kemma kondung botuhau sangi mong erema feec, ihai emma wage dumbengau hendanggeu serimanu siritembong yadango wage buyaubigeng kpedzameec.
Wage dzameu witicamangic yeni fifia mema worabauac wasaingic yeneng yunuhomebeso degec.
Ifi degec wasaingic garengnginango Pauro onggongeudeac negemma kpetariyemmema yofi edeyunuec, “Fifia meme ngeneng kondunnu waraima yuma kemema fifia mema tegiau enggec.
Amma goa neneng katapa witiau nga goa wage kpedzac kpedzamea witiau kenggec.” Neni nenahafoc ifingo ifi amma tegiau endacni nenearunac monggac sebia mi manganeec.
